name: IKEDA ENDOSCOPY AFRICA Ltd
tagline: Multi-specialty medical equipment, endoscopic precision at the core.
address: Kigali, Kicukiro, Masaka, Cyimo, Kabeza — Rwanda
workingHours: Mon – Fri: 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM | 24/7 Emergency Technical Support
mission: To equip healthcare providers across Rwanda and Africa with reliable, high-grade medical equipment and dedicated technical expertise — anchored in advanced laparoscopic and endoscopic innovations for surgery, gynecology, and urology — empowering every facility to deliver safer, minimally invasive care.
vision: To be East and Central Africa's premier partner in medical endoscopy and hospital instrumentation, celebrated for dependable supply, clinical training, and uninterrupted field service.
about: IKEDA ENDOSCOPY AFRICA Ltd supplies and supports precision medical technology across hospital departments. Based in Kigali (Kicukiro, Masaka, Cyimo, Kabeza), Rwanda, we combine high-resolution 4K and Full HD laparoscopic video towers, rigid optics, and electrosurgery with comprehensive department equipment spanning neonatology, intensive care, radiology, and maternity — backed by certified local biomedical service engineers.
